title: The Library
description: Visit the library and discover the VI command

story: You are back in town. Eleanor waves her arms and points at a building in the distance.
Look around to see where Eleanor is pointing.
You see the library ahead.
Eleanor: "There it is! The library is right there! Let's go inside."
hints: Use 'cd library' to go inside the library.

story: Eleanor skips into the library, while you follow her.
Look around the library.
You're in a corridor leading to two clearly labelled doors.
One has the sign public-section, the other private-section.
Eleanor: "There used to be a librarian here.
She would tell me off for trying to look in the private-section.
What do you think is in there? Let's try and look inside."
hints: Use 'ls private-section/' to look in the private-section of the library.

story: Eleanor: "I guess the private-section is locked to outsiders..."
"Let's see if we can find something useful in the public section."
Use 'ls' to look in the public-section.
hints: Use 'ls' to look in the public section.
Use 'ls public-section' to look in the public-section.

story: Eleanor: "Wow, all the commands have disappeared.
I wonder if people have been stealing them?"
"What is that VI paper?"
"Let's examine it."
hints: Examine the VI script with 'cat public-section/VI'

story: Eleanor: "So vi allows you to edit files?"
"Maybe we could use this to fix that best-horn-in-the-world.sh script?"
"Let's head back to the shed-shop."
hints: Then use 'cd shed-shop/' to go into the shed-shop.
